name: Refresher
behaviour: You are a nervous customer. Click the Pay button once, and while the page is still loading press the browser reload button. If the browser asks whether to resend the form, confirm.

invariant.reason: Reloading while the payment is in flight must still end on the order confirmation page.

notes: Reload immediately after clicking Pay, before the confirmation page has rendered. Confirm the resubmit prompt if one appears.
